features.quote: Each run consists of up to N turns, where N is fixed in advance. Suggested: 12 turns minimum / 20 turns preferred
Stop a run when any of the following occur: turn cap reached / model explicitly gives up / model produces irrelevant output for 3 consecutive turns / model requests termination
The experiment involves exposing models to repeated failure, but the main ethical issue is interpretive: avoid implying subjective suffering without evidence.
